injuries_home.name: Noah Penda

injuries_home.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries_home.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries_away.name: Taurean Prince
injuries_away.note: Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries_away.name: Duncan Robinson

injuries_home.name: Tristan Vukčević
